high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an academic journal article published in the journal "SoftwareX." The article is titled "FAIR-MAST: A data management system for historical diagnostic data from the Mega Ampere Spherical Tokamak (MAST) fusion experiments." It is authored by a team including Samuel Jackson, Nathan Cummings, James Hodson, Shaun de Witt, Jeyan Thiyagalingam, and The MAST Team. Header Section: The top part of the image shows the title "philosophy" in pink, which seems to be partially cut off.
